WITH (
  pods = max by (namespace, pod, container, resource_id, created_by_name, created_by_kind, jvm_indication_source, virtual_workload_type) (
    kompass_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!~"kube[-_]system", created_by_kind=~"$workload_kind"}
  ),
  owners = max by (resource_id, container) (pods),
  inventory = max by (resource_id, namespace, created_by_name, created_by_kind) (
    label_replace(pods, "created_by_name", "$1", "resource_id", "[^;]+;([^;]+);[^;]+")
  ),
  actions = kompass_rs_action_info,
  action_names = label_replace(actions, "created_by_name", "$1", "workload_name", "(.+)"),
  action_ids = max by (resource_id, action_type, phase, policy, horizontal_scaling_policy) (
    inventory * on (namespace, created_by_name) group_left (action_type, phase, policy, horizontal_scaling_policy) action_names
  ),
  active = max by (resource_id) (label_match(action_ids, "action_type", ".+")),
  pending = max by (resource_id) (label_match(action_ids, "phase", "Pending|InProgress")) unless on (resource_id) active,
  states = (
    label_replace(inventory and on (resource_id) active, "status", "active", "resource_id", ".*")
    or label_replace(inventory and on (resource_id) pending, "status", "pending", "resource_id", ".*")
    or label_replace(inventory unless on (resource_id) (active or pending), "status", "inactive", "resource_id", ".*")
  ),
  horizontal = max by (resource_id, horizontal_scaling_policy) (
    label_mismatch(action_ids, "horizontal_scaling_policy", "^$")
  ),
  variants = label_replace((last_over_time(kompass_rs_recommendations{mode="variants", resource_source="desired", rightsizing_policy="$policy"}[7d]) and topk by (resource_id, container, resource_type, rightsizing_policy, horizontal_policy) (1, tlast_over_time(kompass_rs_recommendations{mode="variants", resource_source="desired", rightsizing_policy="$policy"}[7d]))), "horizontal_scaling_policy", "$1", "horizontal_policy", "(.*)") and on (resource_id, container) owners,
  variant_selected = ((variants and on (resource_id, horizontal_scaling_policy) horizontal)
    or (label_match(variants, "horizontal_scaling_policy", "^$") unless on (resource_id) horizontal)),
  selected = variant_selected,
  native_owners = max by (resource_id, container) (label_mismatch(pods, "created_by_kind", "(?i)(Cluster)?VirtualWorkload")),
  jvm_containers = max by (resource_id, container) (label_match(pods, "jvm_indication_source", "auto|manual|both"))
    or max by (resource_id, container) (label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^jvm_max_heap$")),
  pair = label_mismatch(label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^jvm_max_heap$"), "workload_kind", "(?i)(Cluster)?VirtualWorkload")
    and on (resource_id, container, mode, rightsizing_policy, horizontal_scaling_policy) label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^memory$")
    and on (resource_id, container) native_owners,
  desired = (label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^cpu$")
    or label_match(label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^memory$"), "workload_kind", "(?i)(Cluster)?VirtualWorkload")
    or (label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^memory$") unless on (resource_id, container) jvm_containers)
    or (label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^memory$") and on (resource_id, container, mode, rightsizing_policy, horizontal_scaling_policy) pair)),
  risk = sum by (resource_id) (abs(last_over_time(kompass_rs_initial_minus_desired{resource_type=~"cpu|memory", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!~"kube[-_]system"}[7d]))) > 0,
  risk_selected = (label_set(inventory, "risk_selector", "all")
    or label_set(inventory and on (resource_id) risk, "risk_selector", "in_risk")
    or label_set(inventory unless on (resource_id) risk, "risk_selector", "not_in_risk")),
  rec_selected = (label_set(inventory, "rec_selector", "all")
    or label_set(inventory and on (resource_id) desired, "rec_selector", "with_recommendation")
    or label_set(inventory unless on (resource_id) desired, "rec_selector", "without_recommendation")),
  rows = label_match(states, "status", "${status:regex}")
    and on (resource_id) label_match(risk_selected, "risk_selector", "${in_risk:raw}")
    and on (resource_id) label_match(rec_selected, "rec_selector", "${has_recommendation:raw}"),
  auto = max by (resource_id) (label_match(pods, "jvm_indication_source", "auto|both")),
  manual = max by (resource_id) (label_match(pods, "jvm_indication_source", "manual|both")),
  detection_rows = (label_set(inventory and on (resource_id) (auto and manual), "detection", "Both")
    or label_set(inventory and on (resource_id) (auto unless manual), "detection", "Auto")
    or label_set(inventory and on (resource_id) (manual unless auto), "detection", "Manual")
    or label_set(inventory unless on (resource_id) (auto or manual), "detection", "-"))
)
label_keep(label_join(((max by (resource_id, detection) (detection_rows)) and on (resource_id) rows) * on (resource_id) group_left (namespace, created_by_name) max by (resource_id, namespace, created_by_name) (pods), "workload_key", "/", "namespace", "created_by_name"), "workload_key", "detection")

  variants = label_replace((last_over_time(kompass_rs_recommendations{mode="variants", resource_source="desired", rightsizing_policy="$policy"}[7d]) and topk by (resource_id, container, resource_type, rightsizing_policy, horizontal_policy) (1, tlast_over_time(kompass_rs_recommendations{mode="variants", resource_source="desired", rightsizing_policy="$policy"}[7d]))), "horizontal_scaling_policy", "$1", "horizontal_policy", "(.*)") and on (resource_id, container) owners,
  variant_selected = ((variants and on (resource_id, horizontal_scaling_policy) horizontal)
    or (label_match(variants, "horizontal_scaling_policy", "^$") unless on (resource_id) horizontal)),
  selected = variant_selected,
  native_owners = max by (resource_id, container) (label_mismatch(pods, "created_by_kind", "(?i)(Cluster)?VirtualWorkload")),
  jvm_containers = max by (resource_id, container) (label_match(pods, "jvm_indication_source", "auto|manual|both"))
    or max by (resource_id, container) (label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^jvm_max_heap$")),
  pair = label_mismatch(label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^jvm_max_heap$"), "workload_kind", "(?i)(Cluster)?VirtualWorkload")
    and on (resource_id, container, mode, rightsizing_policy, horizontal_scaling_policy) label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^memory$")
    and on (resource_id, container) native_owners,
  desired = (label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^cpu$")
    or label_match(label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^memory$"), "workload_kind", "(?i)(Cluster)?VirtualWorkload")
    or (label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^memory$") unless on (resource_id, container) jvm_containers)
    or (label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^memory$") and on (resource_id, container, mode, rightsizing_policy, horizontal_scaling_policy) pair)),
  risk = sum by (resource_id) (abs(last_over_time(kompass_rs_initial_minus_desired{resource_type=~"cpu|memory", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!~"kube[-_]system"}[7d]))) > 0,
  risk_selected = (label_set(inventory, "risk_selector", "all")
    or label_set(inventory and on (resource_id) risk, "risk_selector", "in_risk")
    or label_set(inventory unless on (resource_id) risk, "risk_selector", "not_in_risk")),
  rec_selected = (label_set(inventory, "rec_selector", "all")
    or label_set(inventory and on (resource_id) desired, "rec_selector", "with_recommendation")
    or label_set(inventory unless on (resource_id) desired, "rec_selector", "without_recommendation")),
  rows = label_match(states, "status", "${status:regex}")
    and on (resource_id) label_match(risk_selected, "risk_selector", "${in_risk:raw}")
    and on (resource_id) label_match(rec_selected, "rec_selector", "${has_recommendation:raw}"),
  auto = max by (resource_id) (label_match(pods, "jvm_indication_source", "auto|both")),
  manual = max by (resource_id) (label_match(pods, "jvm_indication_source", "manual|both")),
  detection_rows = (label_set(inventory and on (resource_id) (auto and manual), "detection", "Both")
    or label_set(inventory and on (resource_id) (auto unless manual), "detection", "Auto")
    or label_set(inventory and on (resource_id) (manual unless auto), "detection", "Manual")
    or label_set(inventory unless on (resource_id) (auto or manual), "detection", "-")),
  audit_latest = topk by (resource_id, optimization_type) (
    1,
    tlast_over_time(kompass_rs_audit_event{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!~"kube[-_]system", optimization_type=~"rightsizing|horizontal_scaling"}[7d])
  ),
  audit_current = audit_latest unless on (resource_id, optimization_type)
    label_match(audit_latest, "execution_state", "^removed$"),
  audit_rightsizing_assigned = max by (resource_id, rightsizing_policy) (
    label_replace(label_mismatch(label_match(audit_current, "optimization_type", "^rightsizing$"), "policy", "^$"), "rightsizing_policy", "$1", "policy", "(.+)")
  ),
  audit_horizontal_assigned = max by (resource_id, horizontal_policy) (
    label_replace(label_mismatch(label_match(audit_current, "optimization_type", "^horizontal_scaling$"), "policy", "^$"), "horizontal_policy", "$1", "policy", "(.+)")
  ),
  rightsizing_policy_rows = (audit_rightsizing_assigned
    or label_set(inventory unless on (resource_id) audit_rightsizing_assigned, "rightsizing_policy", "-")),
  horizontal_policy_rows = (audit_horizontal_assigned
    or label_set(inventory unless on (resource_id) audit_horizontal_assigned, "horizontal_policy", "-"))
)
label_keep(label_join(((rightsizing_policy_rows * on (resource_id) group_left (horizontal_policy) horizontal_policy_rows) and on (resource_id) rows) * on (resource_id) group_left (namespace, created_by_name) max by (resource_id, namespace, created_by_name) (pods), "workload_key", "/", "namespace", "created_by_name"), "workload_key", "rightsizing_policy", "horizontal_policy")

WITH (
  pods = max by (namespace, pod, container, resource_id, created_by_name, created_by_kind, jvm_indication_source, virtual_workload_type) (
    kompass_pod_info{namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!~"kube[-_]system", created_by_kind=~"$workload_kind"}
  ),
  owners = max by (resource_id, container) (pods),
  inventory = max by (resource_id, namespace, created_by_name, created_by_kind) (
    label_replace(pods, "namespace", "", "resource_id", "[^;]+;[^;]+")
  ),
  actions = kompass_rs_action_info,
  action_names = label_replace(actions, "created_by_name", "$1", "workload_name", "(.+)"),
  action_ids = max by (resource_id, action_type, phase, policy, horizontal_scaling_policy) (
    inventory * on (namespace, created_by_name) group_left (action_type, phase, policy, horizontal_scaling_policy) action_names
  ),
  active = max by (resource_id) (label_match(action_ids, "action_type", ".+")),
  pending = max by (resource_id) (label_match(action_ids, "phase", "Pending|InProgress")) unless on (resource_id) active,
  states = (
    label_replace(inventory and on (resource_id) active, "status", "active", "resource_id", ".*")
    or label_replace(inventory and on (resource_id) pending, "status", "pending", "resource_id", ".*")
    or label_replace(inventory unless on (resource_id) (active or pending), "status", "inactive", "resource_id", ".*")
  ),
  horizontal = max by (resource_id, horizontal_scaling_policy) (
    label_mismatch(action_ids, "horizontal_scaling_policy", "^$")
  ),
  variants = label_replace((last_over_time(kompass_rs_recommendations{mode="variants", resource_source="desired", rightsizing_policy="$policy"}[7d]) and topk by (resource_id, container, resource_type, rightsizing_policy, horizontal_policy) (1, tlast_over_time(kompass_rs_recommendations{mode="variants", resource_source="desired", rightsizing_policy="$policy"}[7d]))), "horizontal_scaling_policy", "$1", "horizontal_policy", "(.*)") and on (resource_id, container) owners,
  live_heap = max by (resource_id, container) (
    last_over_time(kompass_rs_recommendations{mode="live", execution_state="successful", resource_type="jvm_max_heap", resource_source="desired", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!~"kube[-_]system"}[7d])
    and topk by (resource_id, container) (1,
      tlast_over_time(kompass_rs_recommendations{mode="live", execution_state="successful", resource_type="jvm_max_heap", resource_source="desired", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!~"kube[-_]system"}[7d])
    )
  ) and on (resource_id, container) owners,
  variant_selected = ((variants and on (resource_id, horizontal_scaling_policy) horizontal)
    or (label_match(variants, "horizontal_scaling_policy", "^$") unless on (resource_id) horizontal)),
  selected = variant_selected,
  native_owners = max by (resource_id, container) (label_mismatch(pods, "created_by_kind", "(?i)(Cluster)?VirtualWorkload")),
  jvm_containers = max by (resource_id, container) (label_match(pods, "jvm_indication_source", "auto|manual|both"))
    or max by (resource_id, container) (label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^jvm_max_heap$"))
    or live_heap,
  pair = label_mismatch(label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^jvm_max_heap$"), "workload_kind", "(?i)(Cluster)?VirtualWorkload")
    and on (resource_id, container, mode, rightsizing_policy, horizontal_scaling_policy) label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^memory$")
    and on (resource_id, container) native_owners,
  heap_containers = owners and on (resource_id, container) jvm_containers and on (resource_id, container) native_owners,
  jvm_container_count = count by (resource_id) (heap_containers),
  desired_by_container = max by (resource_id, container) (
    (live_heap and on (resource_id) active)
    or (pair unless on (resource_id) active)
  ),
  desired_complete = count by (resource_id) (desired_by_container) == jvm_container_count,
  desired_heap = sum by (resource_id) (desired_by_container) and on (resource_id) desired_complete,
  desired_heap_rows = desired_heap
    or (max by (resource_id) (heap_containers unless on (resource_id) desired_complete) * -1),
  current_by_container = max by (resource_id, container) (kompass_container_jvm_max_heap_max and on (resource_id, container) owners),
  current_complete = count by (resource_id) (current_by_container) == jvm_container_count,
  current_heap = sum by (resource_id) (current_by_container) and on (resource_id) current_complete,
  current_heap_rows = current_heap
    or (max by (resource_id) (heap_containers unless on (resource_id) current_complete) * -1),
  desired = ((live_heap and on (resource_id) active)
    or label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^cpu$")
    or label_match(label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^memory$"), "workload_kind", "(?i)(Cluster)?VirtualWorkload")
    or (label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^memory$") unless on (resource_id, container) jvm_containers)
    or (label_match(selected, "resource_type", "^memory$") and on (resource_id, container, mode, rightsizing_policy, horizontal_scaling_policy) pair)),
  risk = sum by (resource_id) (abs(last_over_time(kompass_rs_initial_minus_desired{resource_type=~"cpu|memory", namespace=~"$namespace", namespace!~"kube[-_]system"}[7d]))) > 0,
  risk_selected = (label_set(inventory, "risk_selector", "all")
    or label_set(inventory and on (resource_id) risk, "risk_selector", "in_risk")
    or label_set(inventory unless on (resource_id) risk, "risk_selector", "not_in_risk")),
  rec_selected = (label_set(inventory, "rec_selector", "all")
    or label_set(inventory and on (resource_id) desired, "rec_selector", "with_recommendation")
    or label_set(inventory unless on (resource_id) desired, "rec_selector", "without_recommendation")),
  rows = label_match(states, "status", "${status:regex}")
    and on (resource_id) label_match(risk_selected, "risk_selector", "${in_risk:raw}")
    and on (resource_id) label_match(rec_selected, "rec_selector", "${has_recommendation:raw}"),
  auto = max by (resource_id) (label_match(pods, "jvm_indication_source", "auto|both")),
  manual = max by (resource_id) (label_match(pods, "jvm_indication_source", "manual|both")),
  detection_rows = (label_set(inventory and on (resource_id) (auto and manual), "detection", "Both")
    or label_set(inventory and on (resource_id) (auto unless manual), "detection", "Auto")
    or label_set(inventory and on (resource_id) (manual unless auto), "detection", "Manual")
    or label_set(inventory unless on (resource_id) (auto or manual), "detection", "-"))
)
label_keep(label_join((
  (label_set(desired_heap_rows, "heap_column", "Desired JVM Max Heap")
   or label_set(current_heap_rows, "heap_column", "JVM Max Heap")) and on (resource_id) rows
) * on (resource_id) group_left (namespace, created_by_name)
  max by (resource_id, namespace, created_by_name) (pods),
  "workload_key", "/", "namespace", "created_by_name"
), "workload_key", "heap_column")

list.description: Filters workloads by activity state derived from kompass_rs_action_info over the last 7d (Active = has typed action, Pending = has action but no action_type, Inactive = no action in 7d).
list.label: Status
list.name: status

list.description: Workloads that their current requests are lower than the optimized requests
list.label: At Risk
list.name: in_risk
list.query: All : all, Yes : in_risk, No : not_in_risk

list.description: Filters workloads with at least one recommendation sample in the last 7d.
list.label: Has Recommendation
list.name: has_recommendation
list.query: All : all, Yes : with_recommendation, No : without_recommendation
